title: Pydantic AI Integrations
summary: This module serves as the integration layer for the Pydantic AI framework, connecting its core components with a wide array of external Large Language Model (LLM) providers, embedding services, and other third-party tools. It provides a unified interface for interacting with diverse AI services and platforms.

nodes.label: Integrate LLM Providers
nodes.title: LLM Provider Integrations
nodes.description: Connects to various Large Language Model APIs, handling authentication, client instantiation, and model-specific configurations.

nodes.label: Adapt LLM Behaviors
nodes.title: Model-Specific Adapters
nodes.description: Provides specialized logic for different LLM providers, managing unique behaviors like tool forcing, usage mapping, and streaming responses.

nodes.label: Manage Text Embeddings
nodes.title: Text Embedding Services
nodes.description: Offers a unified interface for generating text embeddings using diverse models and providers, including usage tracking and configuration.

nodes.label: Connect External Tools
nodes.title: External Tool & Framework Integrations
nodes.description: Facilitates integration with third-party toolsets and frameworks, adapting them for use within the Pydantic AI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Pydantic AI Core
nodes.title: Pydantic AI Core Framework
nodes.description: The foundational components of the Pydantic AI framework, including core utilities and abstractions.

nodes.label: LLM Model Abstraction
nodes.title: LLM Model Abstraction Layer
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for interacting with Large Language Models, used by providers and adapters.

nodes.label: Agent Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Agent Capabilities & Tool Management
nodes.description: Manages the definition, discovery, and execution of agent capabilities and tools.

groups.label: LLM Integration Layer
groups.title: LLM Integration Layer
groups.description: Components responsible for connecting to and adapting to various Large Language Model APIs and their unique behaviors.

groups.label: Embedding Integration
groups.title: Embedding Service Integration
groups.description: Manages the integration and usage of different text embedding models and services.

groups.label: Third-Party Extensions
groups.title: External Tool & Framework Extensions
groups.description: Provides mechanisms for integrating Pydantic AI with external toolsets and other frameworks.
